# Introduction

The Standing iron torch is a light source.
It can hold up to six Resin at once. With 1/6 fuel, a standing iron torch will last for 5 hours and 33 minutes. At maximum capacity, a standing iron torch should burn for 33 hours and 20 minutes. This duration is the same for the Standing green-burning iron torch, Standing blue-burning iron torch and Sconce.

Categorias: Furniture, Light sources
